newsitem.title: FINLAND: LEMMINKAINEN SEES OVER FIM 70 MLN '96 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: LEMMINKAINEN SEES OVER FIM 70 MLN '96 PROFIT.

text.p: Finnish construction group Lemminkainen Oy said in a statement on Thursday it expected 1996 pre-tax profit to exceed 70 million markka and so beat its own earlier full-year earnings forecast.
"The profit of the Lemminkainen group for the year 1996 will rise and become better than earlier forecast. The current profit forecast is over 70 million markka," Lemminkainen said.
On August 30, reporting first-half figures, the construction group said it did not expect full-year 1996 pre-tax profit to exceed the previous year's 57.7 million markka.

"But the end of the year was more favourable as demand in some segments of construction picked up and simultaneously some of the parent company's seasonal projects could be continued longer into the autumn than usual," Lemminkainen said.
